none: PAS FindID 1002715: Coin - nummus of Constantius II
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

A worn copper-alloy 4th-century Roman nummus of Constantius II, 'GLORIA EXRCITVS' second issue. Two soldiers one standard on the reverse. Unclear mint. Dating to AD 335-337. Obverse description: bust facing right. Obverse inscription: Ilegible. Reverse description: Two soldiers holding one standard. Reverse inscription: [GLOR IAEXERC] ITVS. Diameter: 14.63 mm; thickness: 1.25 mm; Weight: 1.14g
